dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute bilateral medial longitudinal fasciculus ischemic infarction in the dorsomedial pons causing bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia with see-saw nystagmus, due to posterior-circulation atherosclerotic small-vessel disease associated with uncontrolled diabetes and left posterior cerebral artery stenosis.

ALTERNATIVE: Posterior-circulation embolic ischemic stroke involving the pons and left thalamus.

ALTERNATIVE: Multiple sclerosis causing bilateral internuclear ophthalmoplegia.

ALTERNATIVE: Ocular myasthenia gravis.
